text:
Jordan (Product): Hey team — quick copy review for the Workspace deletion modal. Current text: 'Delete workspace? This cannot be undone.' feels terse and maybe not clear about scope of data loss.
Priya (Design): +1. Feels alarmist but vague. We should call out what is removed (projects, settings, audit logs?) and whether org-level links are affected.
Ethan (Frontend): Are we also planning an undo? Right now the flow is destructive immediately after confirm.
Jordan (Product): Proposal: change modal body to: 'Permanently delete this workspace and all associated projects, API keys, and logs. This action cannot be undone.' And after deletion show a toast: 'Workspace deleted — Undo' available for 30s.
Priya (Design): Sounds clearer. I prefer: Title = 'Permanently delete workspace' CTA = red 'Delete workspace' Secondary = 'Cancel' Body = your proposed sentence + small helper line: 'You have 30 seconds to undo this action.'
Marta (Accessibility): A couple accessibility nits: 1) Modal needs role=dialog and focus trap. 2) The toast undo must announce via aria-live so screen readers hear 'Workspace deleted. Undo available.' 3) Avoid using only 'This action cannot be undone' as the only context — say what is deleted.
Ethan (Frontend): Implementation Qs: toast aria-live="polite" or "assertive"? If assertive it might interrupt. For destructive actions maybe assertive is better.
Marta (Accessibility): Use assertive for the initial delete announcement but keep it short. The undo button should be keyboard-focusable and include aria-label='Undo delete workspace'. Also ensure focus returns to trigger after close.
Priya (Design): Microcopy tweak: use sentence case for CTA ('Delete workspace') and muted helper copy color.
Jordan (Product): Ops: ops-bot will log workspace.delete to audits. Do we mention audit logs in modal? Maybe just a buried line: 'This action is recorded in audit logs.' if helpful.
Ethan (Frontend): For keyboard flow: Esc closes modal, Enter confirms. No typing-confirmation for workspace deletes for now, right?
Jordan (Product): Correct — single confirm + 30s undo toast. We can add required typing for org-level deletes later.
Priya (Design): Also prefer helper copy: 'You have 30 seconds to undo this action.' rather than 'You\u2019ll have...'.
Ethan (Frontend): I'll implement: modal copy, role/focus trap, confirm button text, toast with aria-live='assertive' and Undo button aria-label.
Marta (Accessibility): Add screen-reader-only region that enumerates deleted resource types or counts if available. If not, use pluralizable list: 'associated projects, API keys, and logs.'
ops-bot: Audit: workspace.delete event logged to audits service with actor=jordan, ts=2301112223.
Priya (Design): I'll update Figma copy, include muted helper and focus order notes.
Jordan (Product): Decision: change copy to the approved string, add toast undo, no typing confirmation. Action items below.
Ethan (Frontend): ACTION: PR with modal + toast + a11y labels by end of sprint.
Priya (Design): ACTION: Update Figma and handoff copy tokens.
Marta (Accessibility): ACTION: Add SR test case and checklist entry for aria-live and Undo button focus.
Jordan (Product): @Priya please add final approved string to the PR so translations sees it.
Priya (Design): Will do. :white_check_mark:
Ethan (Frontend): Quick Q: should toast include 'View workspace' link? That could re-open a 404.
Jordan (Product): Keep toast minimal. Undo only.
Marta (Accessibility): Last nit: close icon needs aria-label='Close dialog' and focus return after close/undo.
Priya (Design): Ack.
Jordan (Product): Thanks, moving to implement. I'll reopen thread if we need stronger safeguards.
